recommendation: Keep the source fix. No further core edits are indicated for removed listed profiles; if those profiles are reintroduced later, use the same typed-choice slice representation.
issue_request: FHIR-39181 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked that core profiles stop using renamed choice-type element ids and paths such as Observation.valueQuantity, GuidanceResponse.moduleUri, Observation.effectiveDateTime, and ArtifactAssessment.citeAs/artifact; the requested representation is the sliced choice form such as Observation.value[x]:valueQuantity.
initial_application: No repository commit explicitly mentions FHIR-39181. Current source showed partial later cleanup: BP component slices and the vital-signs base profile already use value[x]:valueQuantity forms, and several listed profiles were removed, but eight active single-value vital-sign profiles still used obsolete Observation.valueQuantity id/path entries.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Observation as an active current-build resource. Later commits removed diagnostic-report lipid profiles, DeviceMetricObservation, CDS Hooks GuidanceResponse, and EBMRecommendation profile source, so those Jira-listed artifacts are no longer current source-edit targets. FHIR-I minutes record the 2022-11-14 Persuasive vote, and exact Zulip issue-key search found no conflicting discussion.
